name: Jehu
bio: Jehu son of Hanani was a prophet through whom the word of the LORD came against Baasha, king of Israel. Jehu declared that although the LORD had raised Baasha up from nothing to lead Israel, he had walked in the sinful ways of Jeroboam and led Israel into sin, so the LORD would destroy Baasha's entire house just as he had destroyed Jeroboam's (1 Kings 16:1-4, 7). Years later, Jehu went out to meet King Jehoshaphat of Judah on his return from allying with Ahab, asking how he could help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD, and warning that the LORD's wrath was upon him for it — though he also commended Jehoshaphat for removing the Asherah poles and setting his heart to seek God (2 Chronicles 19:1-3).
